name: executing-plans
title_zh: 带着书面计划跨会话执行，每步设卡等你验收
tagline_zh: 写好的实施计划别烂在文档里。它帮你拆成可执行步骤，在独立会话中推进，每到检查点就停下来等你确认，不跑偏、不返工。
tagline_en: Stop letting implementation plans rot in docs. It breaks them into steps, works in separate sessions, and halts.
desc_en: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints
why_zh: 把「计划」和「执行」彻底分离：它只认你写下的书面方案，不靠对话记忆，每到一个检查点就硬停。
why_en: Splits planning from execution: it only follows your written plan, ignores chat memory, and hard-stops at every checkpoint until.
limit_zh: 只认结构化的书面实施计划（含步骤与检查点）；计划外的临时改动它不会主动处理，需要你重写计划再交给它。不负责生成计划本身。
limit_en: Requires a structured written plan with steps & checkpoints; won't improvise beyond it. Doesn't write the plan for you.
title_en: Execute your written plan across sessions, with review.
